explicit_change: Add maxCutBonds=mol.GetNumBonds() to FragmentMol, removing hidden default20 cutoff. No 2/3-cut or alternative bond patterns searched.
canonical: RDKit MolToSmiles canonical+isomeric default; no salt/tautomer standardization added
scaffold: Exact nonempty MurckoScaffoldSmiles includeChirality=False; empty remains ungrouped except canonical/MMP links
graph: Union canonical, nonempty scaffold and single-cut MMP relationships. Spanning edges preserve the full logical connected components; candidate-pair occurrences across cores are not unique MMP pair counts.
necessary_checks: For exact 60/20/20 target ratios: >=3 components and largest<=ceil(0.6*N) are necessary only, not sufficient. No cliff power/quality/date or formal confirmability claim.
scope: Development structures of 3 already seen tasks only; graph complete for frozen finite single-cut definition, not all possible MMP definitions or full30/test benchmark
